headlines.text: Flash back to 2021, when gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Heavyweight Title found a new champion as Adam Page vs. Kenny Omega battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 9.26 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. This stood as the 20th match in AEW World Heavyweight Title history ? a notable milestone for the title. The culmination of a two-year journey ? Page returned to his newborn baby as AEW's new World Champion, ending Omega's record 346-day reign with his own Buckshot Lariat, while The Young Bucks watched ringside without interfering, a quiet, telling moment in the slow reunion of The Elite.
Rewind to 2024, when C.Cage & Page made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.48.

On this day in 2019, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as SCU (Kaz & Sky) vs. The Inner Circle (Guevara & Jericho) went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.32. The Inner Circle (Guevara & Jericho) was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2021, The Lucha Brothers vs. FTR went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Full Gear, rated 7.37 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

Flash back to 2021, when Dan Lambert stepped through the curtain for the first time in a Minneapolis Street Fight match against American Top Team vs. Proud-N-Powerful vs. Men of the Year vs. Chris Jericho vs. Jake Hager vs. Sammy Guevara vs. Ortiz vs. Santana vs. Andrei Arlovski vs. Junior Dos Santos vs. Ethan Page vs. Scorpio Sky, appearing on Full Gear, rated 5.72.
Back on this day in 2021, CM Punk vs. Eddie Kingston crossed paths for the first time ever on Full Gear, rated 8.48 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle.
